role.altitude: The forensic technician keeps casting impressions, preparing and analysing evidence, comparing marks, testing hypotheses at the scene and drawing conclusions; enhancing images step by step, paging through reference catalogues, writing custody forms and collecting scene files by mail shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A technician whose comparisons start from clean images and complete case files, while every conclusion stays their own.

tasks.short: Photograph and cast impressions, enhance the images with logged steps, search reference databases for sole or tread patterns, examine footwear, tire tracks or other impressions against candidates and known items, and record findings.

steps.what: Technician photographs and casts the impressions
Technician enhances images of the impressions
Technician searches reference collections for footwear sole or tire tread patterns
Technician examines the impressions against candidates and known items and concludes
Technician records the findings in the case file

tasks.design: Image enhancement uses validated presets for contrast and perspective. Every operation is logged, so the original and the steps can be shown in court, instead of enhancing step by step by hand. The technician codes pattern features, and the reference database lists candidate makes by those codes, instead of paging through catalogues. No software compares the impression or draws the conclusion; casting, examination and the conclusion stay with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Images were enhanced by hand and catalogues paged through.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated imaging presets with logs and coded reference databases.
tasks.human_edge: Spotting a wear mark that ties a shoe to one person.

reach.learn: Whether candidate makes come back sooner.

evidence.claim: Official control labs must be accredited to the testing standard, which requires validated software.
AI used by law enforcement to evaluate the reliability of evidence is high-risk under the AI Act, so no model compares or concludes here.

assumptions: Boundary: examining impressions; comparing tools with marks (task 1590) and keeping records and reports (task 18478) are sibling tasks.
s5 is part of keeping records and reports, which sibling task 18478 covers; its saving is counted there.
Input contract for s3: reference databases cover about 70% of common sole and tread patterns; s3 is priced at that share.
Casting and examining keep their full time.
unknowns: Number of impression cases per month.
research_questions: Are candidate makes found sooner without missed matches?

incremental.description: Technician validates presets after software updates.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: unusual patterns; high: common footwear and tires.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Register and inspect evidence items, prepare samples, examine physical evidence such as hair, fluids, fiber, wood or soil residues, capture instrument data, and interpret source and composition.

steps.what: Technician registers evidence items and records each custody transfer
Technician prepares samples for analysis
Technician examines the physical evidence by microscopy and spectroscopy
Technician records instrument data in the case file
Technician interprets the source and composition of the evidence

tasks.design: Evidence items carry barcodes, and each custody transfer is recorded by scanning in the laboratory system, which logs who, when and where, instead of handwritten custody forms. Preparing, examining and interpreting stay with the technician; no software interprets the evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Custody transfers were written on paper forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Barcoded evidence tracking with audit logs.
tasks.still_hard: Items too small or wet to label directly.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing that a fiber was transferred, not shed.

evidence.claim: A laboratory information system barcodes samples, assigns tests and logs each change.

assumptions: Boundary: examining physical evidence; collecting evidence at scenes (task 1577) and keeping records and reports (task 18478) are sibling tasks.
s4 is part of keeping records of findings and techniques, which sibling task 18478 covers; its saving is counted there.
Preparing, examining and interpreting keep their full time.
unknowns: Number of custody transfers per case.

incremental.description: Technician relabels items whose barcodes are damaged.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few items per case; high: many items and transfers.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect scene documentation, build a 3D scene model, test hypotheses on how events unfolded, verify at the scene, and prepare visuals to reconstruct crime scenes and determine relationships among pieces of evidence.

steps.what: Technician collects scene photos, sketches, measurements and reports
Technician builds a 3D model of the crime scenes with evidence positions
Technician tests hypotheses on trajectories, sequences and lines of sight to determine relationships among pieces of evidence
Technician verifies the reconstruction at the scene
Technician prepares visuals of the reconstruction for investigators

tasks.design: The case file in the evidence system holds all scene photos, sketches, measurements and reports, instead of the technician collecting them from colleagues by mail. Point-cloud software builds the 3D scene from laser scan data, and evidence markers are placed from the measurement log. Views from the model become visuals. Testing hypotheses and verifying at the scene stay with the technician; no software decides what happened.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scene files were collected by mail and models built by hand from sketches.
tasks.enabler_now: Case files in evidence systems and point-cloud scene models.
tasks.still_hard: Scenes not scanned before they were cleared.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing which sequence of events the evidence rules out.

evidence.claim: Official control labs must be accredited to the testing standard, which requires validated software.
Point-cloud software builds 3D scene models from laser scans.

assumptions: Boundary: reconstructing scenes; measuring and sketching scenes (task 23965) and testifying in court (task 1571) are sibling tasks.
Input contract for s2: scenes laser-scanned by the scene team through task 23965, for about 50% of serious cases; s2 is priced at that share.
Testing hypotheses and verifying keep their full time.
research_questions: Are reconstructions available earlier in the investigation?

incremental.description: Technician checks marker positions against the measurement log.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: unscanned scenes; high: scanned scenes with full case files.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Examine bullets and casings, look up rifling characteristics, enter items in the ballistic database and review candidates, test-fire and compare, and determine the types of bullets and specific weapons used in shootings.

steps.what: Technician examines bullets and casings: calibre, rifling and marks
Technician looks up rifling characteristics to list possible weapon makes
Technician enters items in the ballistic database and reviews the candidate list
Technician test-fires suspect weapons and compares marks under the comparison microscope
Technician determines the types of bullets and the specific weapons used

tasks.design: A rifling characteristics database lists possible weapon makes from the measured land and groove counts and widths, instead of the technician paging through printed tables. The ballistic database step and all comparisons stay as they are. The examiner compares and decides; no software draws the conclusion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rifling tables were looked up on paper.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing matching striations a correlation score misses.

reach.learn: Whether possible weapon types come back sooner.

evidence.claim: AI used by law enforcement to evaluate the reliability of evidence is high-risk under the AI Act, so no model compares or concludes here.

assumptions: Boundary: determining bullets and weapons; analysing gunshot residue and bullet paths (task 1583) and examining firearms (task 1587) are sibling tasks.
Examining, database entry, comparing and concluding keep their full time.
unknowns: Number of shooting cases per month.
research_questions: Is the first weapon-type answer to investigators faster?

incremental.description: Technician adds new rifling data from test fires.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: damaged bullets; high: intact bullets of common calibres.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
